SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT DOC_NAME, KEY_1 AS LEGACY_PO_NO, KEY_2 AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ FROM KEPTRXL WHERE TRIM(KEY_9) IS NULL AND DOC_NAME='PODOWN' ORDER BY KEY_1, KEY_2
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'KA' AS SITE, 'ILCO' AS BUYER, NVL(STATUS,'D') AS STATUS, KEY_1 AS LEGACY_PO_NO, KEY_2 AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, NVL(BUYER_ITEM_NO,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, NVL(UNIT_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE, NVL(ITEM_QTY,0) AS ITEM_QTY, NVL(ITEM_AMT,0) AS ITEM_AMT, NVL(PO_DATE,' ') AS ADD_DATE, NVL(RD_DATE,' ') AS RD_DATE, NVL(DELY_TO_LOCATION,' ') AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, NVL(PURCHASER_USER_ID,' ') AS PURCHASER_USER_ID, NVL(REQ_USER_NAME,' ') AS REQ_USER_NAME, NVL(REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME,' ') AS REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME, NVL(REMARK,' ') AS REMARK FROM VIEW_PO, KEPTRXL WHERE KEY_1 = LEGACY_PO_NO(+) AND KEY_2 = LEGACY_PO_SEQ(+) AND DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND TRIM(KEY_9) IS NULL AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' ORDER BY KEY_1,KEY_2
UPDATE KEPTRXL SET KEY_9 = 'Y', KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND TRIM(KEY_9) IS NULL AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$'
